body: A world where engineering and adventure collide. On this server, we blend the automation and creativity of Create with RPG-style progression, combat, and exploration. Build factories, design impressive mechanisms, and at the same time face off against creatures, level up, and discover a world full of challenges and rewards. Your progress doesn’t depend on strength alone… it also comes down to your ingenuity.
